traits.note: Watson and Dallwitz, The Families of Flowering Plants (DELTA data, items edited May 2026), family Eucommiaceae: leaves alternate; leaves simple; margins serrate or dentate; veins pinnate; leaves deciduous; stipules absent; plants dioecious; ovary superior; stems woody; flowers actinomorphic; perianth absent; fruit samara; stamens (5-) 6 to 10 (-12); carpels 2. Read from the coded states by script (spec-rework/b1/delta/mapdelta.py); a state the authors qualify (rarely, usually, a share) keeps its word, an unqualified one beside a usual state reads as sometimes.
